title: Blinded
subtitle: You can't see
description: You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.

bullets.content: A blinded creature suffers from the following effects:

items: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

bullets.content: These effects apply to any creature that relies on sight.

title: Charmed
subtitle: You are influenced by another
description: You can't attack the charmer or target them with abilities that cause damage or a harmful condition.

bullets.content: In addition, the charmer has Advantage on ability checks to interact socially with you.

title: Deafened
subtitle: You can't hear
description: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

bullets.content: This condition can be caused by magical effects like the Silence spell or by loud noises like a thunderclap.

title: Dying
subtitle: You are at 0 HP and near death
description: When you start your turn with 0 Hit Points, you must make a Death Saving Throw.

bullets.content: At the start of each of your turns while dying, you make a death saving throw. The rules are:

items: Roll a d20. On a 10 or higher, you succeed. Otherwise, you fail.
On your third success, you become Stable.
On your third failure, you die.
Rolling a 1 counts as two failures. Rolling a 20 lets you regain 1 HP.
Taking damage while dying causes one failure (two if from a critical hit).

bullets.content: A stable creature is still Unconscious but no longer dying. It regains 1 HP after 1d4 hours.

title: Exhaustion
subtitle: You are physically drained
description: Exhaustion is measured in levels. Each level imparts a cumulative penalty to your d20 Tests and your Speed.

bullets.content: The levels of exhaustion have the following cumulative effects:
Finishing a Long Rest reduces your Exhaustion level by 1. When your Exhaustion level reaches 0, the condition ends.

title: Frightened
subtitle: You are afraid
description: You have Disadvantage on d20 Tests while the source of your fear is within your line of sight.

bullets.content: In addition, you can't willingly move closer to the source of your fear.

title: Grappled
subtitle: You are held by another
description: While Grappled, your Speed is 0 and cannot be increased.

bullets.content: A grappled creature is affected in the following ways:

items: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.
The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, but its movement is slowed unless you are significantly smaller.

bullets.content: The condition ends if you escape, the grappler is Incapacitated, or you are moved out of the grappler's reach.

title: Incapacitated
subtitle: You are unable to act
description: While Incapacitated, you cannot take any action, bonus action, or reaction.

bullets.content: In addition to being unable to act, you are affected in the following ways:

items: Your Concentration is broken.
You can't speak.
You have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

bullets.content: Many other conditions also apply the Incapacitated condition.

title: Invisible
subtitle: You can't be seen
description: You can't be seen without the aid of magic or a special sense. You are considered Heavily Obscured for the purpose of hiding.

bullets.content: An invisible creature gains the following effects:

items: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and attack rolls unless your target can see you.
Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, unless your attacker can see you.
You aren't affected by any effect that requires its target to be seen.

bullets.content: Any equipment you are wearing or carrying is also concealed.

title: Paralyzed
subtitle: You are physically frozen
description: You are Incapacitated, and your speed is 0.

bullets.content: The creature also suffers from the following effects:

items: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Any attack that hits you is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

bullets.content: This is a severe condition that renders a creature completely helpless.

title: Petrified
subtitle: You are turned to stone
description: You are transformed into a solid inanimate substance, along with any nonmagical objects you are wearing or carrying.

bullets.content: The creature is Incapacitated, its speed is 0, and it ceases aging. In addition:

items: Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage.
It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
It has resistance to all damage and immunity to the Poisoned condition.

bullets.content: The creature's weight is increased by a factor of ten.

title: Poisoned
subtitle: You are suffering from poison
description: While Poisoned, you have Disadvantage on all of your d20 Tests (attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks).

bullets.content: Many monster attacks and poisonous substances can inflict this condition.

title: Prone
subtitle: You are lying on the ground
description: Your only movement option is to Crawl, unless you stand up. If your speed is 0, you can't stand up.

bullets.content: The creature is also affected in the following ways:

items: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet. Otherwise, attacks have Disadvantage.

bullets.content: Standing up costs an amount of movement equal to half your speed.

title: Restrained
subtitle: Your movement is prevented
description: Your Speed is 0 and cannot be increased.

bullets.content: The creature also suffers from the following effects:

items: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

bullets.content: This condition can be caused by spells like Entangle or being held in a giant spider's web.

title: Stunned
subtitle: You are dazed and unable to act
description: You are Incapacitated and can speak only falteringly.

bullets.content: The creature also suffers from the following effects:

items: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

bullets.content: This condition often results from a powerful blow or a stunning magical effect.

title: Unconscious
subtitle: You are senseless
description: You are Incapacitated, Prone, and unaware of your surroundings. You drop whatever you're holding.

bullets.content: In addition, the creature suffers from the following effects:

items: Your speed is 0 and can't increase.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and any hit from within 5 feet is a critical hit.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

bullets.content: This condition occurs when a creature drops to 0 hit points or is rendered unconscious by other means.
